<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink" width="1200" height="820" viewBox="0 0 1200 820">
  <style>
    .jesse { animation: swayJ 1.9s ease-in-out infinite; transform-origin: 410px 630px }
    .walt  { animation: swayW 1.9s ease-in-out infinite; transform-origin: 800px 630px; animation-delay: -.45s }
    @keyframes swayJ { 0%,100% { transform: rotate(-2.5deg) } 25% { transform: translateY(-6px) } 50% { transform: rotate(2.5deg) } 75% { transform: translateY(-6px) } }
    @keyframes swayW { 0%,100% { transform: rotate(-1.2deg) } 50% { transform: rotate(1.2deg) } }
    .prog { animation: prog 12s linear infinite; transform-origin: 470px 0 }
    @keyframes prog { from { transform: scaleX(0) } to { transform: scaleX(1) } }
    .note { animation: note 3s ease-in-out infinite; opacity:0 }
    @keyframes note { 0% { opacity:0; transform: translateY(0) } 30% { opacity:1 } 100% { opacity:0; transform: translateY(-70px) } }
    .glow { animation: glow 1.9s ease-in-out infinite }
    @keyframes glow { 50% { opacity:.55 } }
    .eq rect { animation: eq .9s ease-in-out infinite; transform-box: fill-box; transform-origin: bottom }
    @keyframes eq { 0%,100% { transform: scaleY(.3) } 50% { transform: scaleY(1) } }
  </style>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id="spot" cx="50%" cy="60%" r="50%">
      <stop offset="0" stop-color="#2fa65a" stop-opacity=".22"/><stop offset="1" stop-color="#2fa65a" stop-opacity="0"/>
    </radialGradient>
    <radialGradient id="spot2" cx="50%" cy="60%" r="50%">
      <stop offset="0" stop-color="#3aa8e0" stop-opacity=".2"/><stop offset="1" stop-color="#3aa8e0" stop-opacity="0"/>
    </radialGradient>
  </defs>
  <rect width="1200" height="820" fill="#13171c"/>
  <ellipse cx="420" cy="380" rx="300" ry="320" fill="url(#spot)" class="glow"/>
  <ellipse cx="800" cy="360" rx="300" ry="320" fill="url(#spot2)" class="glow" style="animation-delay:-.95s"/>
  <ellipse cx="410" cy="632" rx="140" ry="14" fill="#000" opacity=".35"/>
  <ellipse cx="800" cy="632" rx="140" ry="14" fill="#000" opacity=".35"/>

  <!-- right character + his earbud wire (wire runs behind both of them) -->
  <g class="walt">
    <path d="M729 222 C700 300 610 345 500 330" stroke="#f4f4f4" stroke-width="4" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <image x="660" y="78" width="281" height="552" href="data:image/png;base64," xlink:href="data:image/png;base64,"/>
    <circle cx="728" cy="214" r="8" fill="#f4f4f4" stroke="#13171c" stroke-width="2"/>
  </g>

  <!-- left character holding the MP3 player -->
  <g class="jesse">
    <path d="M510 262 C505 190 390 205 352 282" stroke="#f4f4f4" stroke-width="4" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <image x="267" y="119" width="286" height="511" href="data:image/png;base64," xlink:href="data:image/png;base64,"/>
    <circle cx="350" cy="284" r="8" fill="#f4f4f4" stroke="#13171c" stroke-width="2"/>
    <g transform="translate(512,292) rotate(-10)">
      <rect x="-21" y="-34" width="42" height="66" rx="8" fill="#f4f4f4" stroke="#13171c" stroke-width="2.5"/>
      <rect x="-15" y="-28" width="30" height="22" rx="3" fill="#2fa65a"/>
      <text x="0" y="-12" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Consolas, Liberation Mono, Menlo, monospace" font-size="10" font-weight="700" fill="#fff">Pt</text>
      <circle cx="0" cy="12" r="11" fill="#2fa65a"/><circle cx="0" cy="12" r="4" fill="#f4f4f4"/>
    </g>
  </g>

  <text x="560" y="230" font-size="30" fill="#7fe0a0" class="note">♪</text>
  <text x="620" y="215" font-size="24" fill="#9fe6ff" class="note" style="animation-delay:1s">♫</text>
  <text x="300" y="200" font-size="22" fill="#9fe6ff" class="note" style="animation-delay:2s">♪</text>
  <text x="880" y="160" font-size="26" fill="#7fe0a0" class="note" style="animation-delay:1.5s">♫</text>

  <g class="eq" fill="#2fa65a">
    <rect x="1020" y="560" width="10" height="60" rx="3"/>
    <rect x="1036" y="560" width="10" height="60" rx="3" style="animation-delay:-.3s"/>
    <rect x="1052" y="560" width="10" height="60" rx="3" style="animation-delay:-.6s"/>
    <rect x="1068" y="560" width="10" height="60" rx="3" style="animation-delay:-.15s"/>
  </g>
  <g class="eq" fill="#3aa8e0">
    <rect x="122" y="560" width="10" height="60" rx="3" style="animation-delay:-.45s"/>
    <rect x="138" y="560" width="10" height="60" rx="3"/>
    <rect x="154" y="560" width="10" height="60" rx="3" style="animation-delay:-.7s"/>
    <rect x="170" y="560" width="10" height="60" rx="3" style="animation-delay:-.2s"/>
  </g>

  <text x="600" y="690" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Georgia, Times New Roman, serif" font-style="italic" font-size="34" fill="#f4f4f4">(っ˘ᵕ˘)っ ♡˚₊ ‘we were never stable,</text>
  <text x="600" y="736" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Georgia, Times New Roman, serif" font-style="italic" font-size="34" fill="#f4f4f4">but we were never boring’</text>
  <text x="600" y="784" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Helvetica Neue, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="28" fill="#f4f4f4" letter-spacing="18">♡ |◁ II ▷| ↻</text>
  <rect x="470" y="800" width="260" height="4" rx="2" fill="#ffffff22"/>
  <rect x="470" y="800" width="260" height="4" rx="2" fill="#7fe0a0" class="prog"/>
</svg>
